asset_requirements.keypoints: Float tensor shaped exactly as the active local_matcher expects for its map-tile keypoints input.
asset_requirements.descriptors: Float tensor shaped exactly as the active local_matcher expects for its map-tile descriptors input.
asset_requirements.map_points_enu_m: Optional N x 3 float array, index-aligned to keypoints. Required for pnp_3d candidate-pose geometry.

notes: feature_uri is resolved relative to this metadata file. The standard MapRelease layout stores metadata in index/ and feature NPZ files in ../features/xfeat/.
The cached features must come from the same local_features export declared in ModelRelease.
The cache is a diagnostic/local-matching artifact, never a direct position measurement.
